name: VayuNetra
inputs: 13 S2 L1C TOA bands (DN/10000, harmonized; order B1..B8,B8A,B9..B12) + ref B11, ref B12 (median of 4 clean passes) + clip(MBMP/0.02,±10) + clip(robust z of MBMP,±8)
scene_score: mean of top-20 pixel probabilities, 4-flip TTA
physics_check: methane if B12 dims >1%, B11 dims <half of B12, visible/NIR change <half of B12; elongated plumes within 45° of wind
loss: positive-only Dice + balanced focal + top-k detection BCE + aux scene BCE
